T_k: The correction keeps a mean-centred, fast-saturating even term in x4 but roughly halves its amplitude, so it runs from about -0.13 at x4 = 0 to about +0.17 at large |x4|, since the earlier version overshot at both ends. The x2*x5 interaction is made steeper but keeps a low cap of +/-0.25, so a moderately positive product (about +0.6) adds about +0.18 and opposite-signed x2 and x5 subtract a similar amount. The total is clipped for stability.
